title: A group-order root cover admits a section over the strict henselization
statement: Let i:U→L be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], G a finite group and W→U a finite etale G-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let R be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], φ:Spec R→L and f∈R a nonzerodivisor with R/(f) regular. Assume |G| is invertible in R. Let β:U×_L Spec R≅D(f) commute with projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let barY:Spec Ω→Spec R be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put H=the canonical affine pointed-neighbourhood coordinate-ring colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let b:R→H induce its canonical structural morphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put g=b(f), n=|G|, A=H[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec H the structural morphism and V=D(g)⊂N. There is s:V→W such that s;π;i=V→N→Spec H→Spec R→L. All schemes and rings have universe u, and G has universe u+1. Only a section over this fixed limit ring is asserted: no finite-stage neighbourhood or coproduct isomorphism is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the finite etale root model theorem to obtain p:E→N and delta over V.

The canonical H is strictly henselian. The polynomial X^|G|-g is monic because a finite group has positive cardinality, so its root algebra is module finite (Polynomial.Monic.finite_adjoinRoot). Apply the finite-algebra etale section theorem to p to get sigma:N→E.

Form l:V→E×_N V from V→N→E and id_V, using sigma;p=id. Compose l with delta and the first projection to W. The pullback condition, the projection equality for delta, and l;snd=id give the required structure equation.

theorem GaloisCover.strict_hensel_root_section
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY) :
    let H := strictHenselizationRing barY
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∃ s : V.toScheme ⟶ W.P,
      s ≫ W.π ≫ i = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ
